{"subject":"Congrats on the May enterprise pilot","body":"Hi,

Congratulations on the enterprise pilot announced in May. Bringing Ledgerly to a Fortune 500 manufacturer's EMEA finance team is a big step, and it follows nicely from making the close automation product generally available in February.

If it's useful, I'd be glad to set up a 20-minute call to hear how the pilot is going and what you're learning from it. Happy to work around your schedule.

Best,
Dana"}
